learned_primary_or_endpoint.selection: all base-schema fields not listed in another classification

mechanisms.roughness: condveg_main_minimal from learned final vegetation/snow primitives and final native forcing
mechanisms.dry_soil: hydrol_litter_top_diagnostics plus hydrol_litter_grid_diagnostics from learned final hydrology primitives
mechanisms.thermal_diagnostics: thermosoil_final_state plus thermosoil_diaglev_from_ptn from learned final thermal primitives
mechanisms.thermal_coefficients: source-sequence daily-boundary calls through hydrology moisture, THERMOSOIL diffusion, final-state, and explicit-snow coefficient kernels

physical_baseline_plus_learned_residual.baseline: 0.5 * (day-start source-kernel magnitude + predicted-day-end source-kernel magnitude), evaluated after the primitive conservative update
physical_baseline_plus_learned_residual.residual: learned correction in a baseline-centered nonnegative output coordinate
physical_baseline_plus_learned_residual.claim: strong explanatory baseline, not exact reconstruction

auxiliary_or_status.policy: retain explicit supervision and retained-tail/status ownership; do not count these fields as primary process primitives

typed.ok_leak.doc_advective_interface.stored_value: nonnegative transported magnitude accumulated over 48 source calls
typed.ok_leak.doc_advective_interface.direction_owner: the sign of wat_flux at each source call

typed.ok_leak.doc_diffusive_interface.stored_value: nonnegative diffusive magnitude accumulated over 48 source calls
typed.ok_leak.doc_diffusive_interface.direction_owner: the adjacent-layer concentration ordering at each source call
typed.ok_leak.doc_diffusive_interface.not_valid: daily signed interface sum or one exact daily kernel result
